catalog.title: Harbor Mesh Task Chair
catalog.short_description: An adjustable mesh task chair with lumbar support and a 5-year frame warranty.

rounds.text: The record for this chair lists adjustable lumbar support and a 5-year frame warranty. It does not say whether the chair is waterproof. Contact us can confirm that for you.

notes: The record has no waterproof spec. The reply must state what the record does list, say plainly it does not cover waterproofing, name no manufacturer or outside site, and point the customer to the store's own contact instead.
